name: Hood's phlox
desc: Hood's phlox (Phlox hoodii): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 9 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Phlox hoodii, the spiny phlox or carpet phlox, is a species of phlox. It is a plant of western North America, where it is a common flower in sagebrush country, mostly growing in dry lithosol habitats.
